tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- Recorded session: navigated to the admin transactions URL, logged in, closed a notification popup, identified stable selectors for the Transactions grid filter controls, entered values for Order ID and Transaction ID, selected Transaction Type, Payment Method and Is Closed, clicked Search and observed zero records found.

Task Definition:
- Provide a deterministic, re-usable tool that navigates to the Magento admin Transactions page, dismisses the notification popup, fills the grid filter controls with supplied values, applies the filters (Search), waits for results, and extracts a short grid summary (current page, total records text). The agent is assumed to already have an authenticated admin session; the tool will not perform login.

Action Plan (to-do list of tool steps):
1. Navigate to the Transactions page URL: '{base_url}/index.php/admin/sales_transactions/'.
2. Wait for the page to load.
3. Click the notification popup close control (recorded elementHash) to ensure the filter row is accessible.
4. Input Order ID into the Order ID filter input (recorded elementHash).
5. Input Transaction ID into the Transaction ID filter input (recorded elementHash).
6. Select Payment Method (recorded elementHash) by visible text {payment_method}.
7. Select Transaction Type (recorded elementHash) by visible text {txn_type}.
8. Select Is Closed (recorded elementHash) by visible text {is_closed}.
9. Input Created At From (CSS selector scoped to grid) with {created_at_from}.
10. Input Created At To (CSS selector scoped to grid) with {created_at_to}.
11. Click the Search / Apply Filters control (recorded elementHash).
12. Wait for results to load and extract grid summary (current page, total records text, records count).

Variable Identification (parameters):
- base_url (required): navigation base used to construct the transactions URL.
- order_id (optional): maps to input[name='order_id'] (filter cell under Order ID).
- txn_id (optional): maps to input[name='txn_id'] or input[name='transaction_id'].
- txn_type (optional): visible option text for select[name='txn_type'].
- payment_method (optional): visible option text for select[name='payment_method'].
- is_closed (optional): visible option text for select[name='is_closed'] ('Yes'/'No').
- created_at_from / created_at_to (optional): mapped to input[name='created_at[from]'] and input[name='created_at[to]'] respectively.

Step Optimization:
- Use recorded elementHash values for deterministic interactions where available (these elementHashes were created during the recording and target unique elements). This avoids fragile class-only selectors and reduces 'resolved to multiple elements' errors seen previously.
- Scope CSS selectors to '#sales_transactions_grid' for inputs lacking elementHash (created_at inputs) to resolve to exactly one element.
- Keep the popup-close click as an unconditional step (recorded environment showed it blocking the filter row). The tool uses the recorded close link elementHash; if the popup isn't present the click may be a no-op in some browsers or cause a selector-not-found error in strict execution environments — caller should ensure the admin session/environment matches the recording.
- No conditional branching is added: all inputs accept empty strings when the caller does not want to filter by that field.

Selectors used (deterministic choices):
- Popup close: elementHash 'df76c6ce85' (a[title='close']).
- Order ID input: elementHash '2e1ab70e63' (input under Order ID filter cell).
- Transaction ID input: elementHash 'aa9671f0a9'.
- Payment Method select: elementHash '197b7e9d27'.
- Transaction Type select: elementHash 'eaf63619c9'.
- Is Closed select: elementHash 'de66e8a7e6'.
- Search button: elementHash 'd8912f9a32'.
- Created At From/To inputs: CSS selectors '#sales_transactions_grid input[name="created_at[from]"]' and '#sales_transactions_grid input[name="created_at[to]"]' (no elementHash recorded for these in the session).
name: magento_admin_search_transactions
description: Navigate to the Magento admin Transactions grid and apply filters (order_id, txn_id, transaction type, payment method, is_closed, created_at range) then apply Search and return the grid summary. Assumes the browser session is already authenticated to admin. Uses recorded stable selectors (elementHash and CSS selectors) from a Magento 1.x admin instance.

steps.description: Open the Magento admin Transactions grid page (assumes admin session already authenticated).
Wait for page resources and grid to load.
Dismiss the Incoming Message / notification popup to expose the grid filters.
Allow popup close animation to finish so inputs become interactable.
Enter Order ID into the Order ID filter input. If empty string is provided, the input will be set to empty.
Enter Transaction ID into the Transaction ID filter input.
Select the provided Payment Method visible option text. Leave empty to skip (select will attempt to match empty text).
Select the provided Transaction Type visible option text.
Select Is Closed option by visible text ('Yes' or 'No').
Enter Created At 'From' date. Scopes the selector to the transactions grid to ensure uniqueness.
Enter Created At 'To' date. Scopes the selector to the transactions grid to ensure uniqueness.
Click the Search / Apply Filters control in the grid filter-actions area.
Wait for the grid to refresh with filter results.
Capture a short summary of the grid after filters were applied to return to the caller.
steps.goal: Extract grid summary: current page, total pages if present, per-page option, total records text and visible grid message (e.g. 'No records found')

input_schema.name: base_url
input_schema.description: Base site URL without trailing slash, e.g. 'http://dockerized-magento.local' — the tool will navigate to '{base_url}/index.php/admin/sales_transactions/'

input_schema.name: order_id
input_schema.description: Order increment ID to filter by (HTML form name: 'order_id'). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: txn_id
input_schema.description: Transaction ID to filter by (form name: 'txn_id' or 'transaction_id'). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: txn_type
input_schema.description: Visible text of the Transaction Type option to select (example: 'Capture', 'Authorization'). Matches option visible text in the select (form name typically 'txn_type').

input_schema.name: payment_method
input_schema.description: Visible text of the Payment Method to select (example: 'PayPal Express Checkout'). Matches option visible text in the select (form name typically 'payment_method').

input_schema.name: is_closed
input_schema.description: Visible text of the Is Closed option to select. Use 'Yes' or 'No' (form name typically 'is_closed').

input_schema.name: created_at_from
input_schema.description: Start date of Created At range in the admin's expected format (e.g. 'MM/DD/YYYY' or locale-specific). Mapped to input[name='created_at[from]']

input_schema.name: created_at_to
input_schema.description: End date of Created At range (mapped to input[name='created_at[to]']).
